joins.evidence: Sumner Link Trail south end == Riverwalk Trail east end in the shipped geometry (exact match); OSM node 6486202530 is shared.

OSM node 2670828792 is shared (Sumner Link way 261467897 / Lake Tapps way 261467941). The shipped simplified Lake Tapps polyline passes this node mid-line, so the app projects the node onto that polyline.

corridors.name: Puyallup valley corridor
corridors.note: Continuous with 0 m road gaps. Rideable length excludes the 2.370 km Sumner Link segment closed to bicycles.

road_links.reason: Military Road East 118 m at 45 mph with no bicycle facility (grade E) and Enchanted Parkway South 470 m as highway=primary (a D10 never-E road class). Removing primary roads, roads >= 40 mph and footways leaves no path between the two trail ends.

618 m of East Valley Highway East carries no maxspeed in OSM and no bicycle facility, and 663 m of A Street Southeast is a 35 mph secondary with no facility (grade D, i.e. about 46% of the link, over the 10% D cap). docs/data/trail-corridor.md calls the link compliant but also names the 720 m of 35 mph road in its headline, so the app treats the link as NOT compliant until the rider's override table proves the speeds.
road_links.source: docs/data/trail-corridor.md section 4 (Corridor A to White River Trail)
